content.text: {"answer": "The OpenTelemetry JS metrics API has no proxy meter. If an instrument is created at module import, before a real MeterProvider is registered, it binds to the no-op meter and stays a permanent no-op. It keeps doing nothing after the provider is set up later. Lore's lore-api counters hit this. The fix, in PR #2652 (the ADR-050 metrics stack), resolves instruments lazily against metrics.getMeterProvider() at use time instead of at import.", "sources": ["Lore memory: session:3addfc0f-6277-4332-abc4-048447be6186", "Lore memory: metrics-stack/2026-10-09 (ADR-050, lore PR #2652)"]}
